quote:
When a nation stings in the night, the sunrise still arrives, bearing both sorrow and renewal.

Smoke that crosses borders is a traveler without a passport, reminding us that pollution follows the wind like gossip.

An army may turn its gaze toward a foreign counsel, yet the river of duty flows toward the homeland unchanged.

A stone launched to orbit whispers that the loftiest dreams begin with a single, daring incantation.

Flags waving in a distant sea speak louder than distant tribunals, yet humility keeps them from being torn by the breeze of arrogance.

When a sea vessel is seized by shadows, it reveals that even tranquil waters conceal tempests of greed.

A lone soul on a hunger strike holds the hunger of a nation, and the world can only listen when its own stomach empties.
